title: Multi-Channel Notification Pipeline Decoupling Domain Events from Deliveries
context: NotificationEvent represents a domain occurrence (PRICE_DROP, ALERT_MATCHED, etc.). Direct synchronous dispatch in web requests causes latency, timeouts, and loss of delivery status. Channel-specific delivery requires decoupled delivery queue.
decision: Preserve NotificationEvent as immutable domain events, introduce NotificationDelivery queue table with unique([eventId, channel]) for idempotency, process delivery in autonomous background worker.
alternatives: Send notifications directly inside web request handler
Treat NotificationEvent as delivery record directly
consequences: Domain events remain decoupled from delivery protocols
Idempotent multi-channel delivery (Email, Telegram, In-App) via NotificationDelivery
Reliable background worker processing with exponential backoff retry and quiet hours
evidence: schema.prisma NotificationEvent model without channel/delivery tracking
